name: web-3d-animal-photo-card-carousel-on-black-with-perspective-tilt
title: Row of animal photo cards (red panda, lion, elephant) tilted in 3D on black, the centre card facing forward with caption
whatItIs: A black background with tall rounded photo cards on a horizontal path that rotate in 3D: the centre card of two lions faces the viewer with a white title 'Lion', an italic Latin name and a photographer credit, while neighbouring cards of a red panda and elephants angle away and narrow.
whatItMeans: Immersive and tactile; tilting cards turn a gallery into a rotating exhibit.
techniques: Show captions on the focus card.

vocabulary.definition: A carousel where side items are angled away.
Text laid over the bottom of a photo.
